summary: Phases out fossil-fuel two-wheeler registrations while committing ₹7,000 crore for EV incentives.

blocks.title: 📰 4. 🌐 NATIONAL, STATE & INTERNATIONAL NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 Delhi EV Policy 2026 (EV Policy 2.0): Bans Petrol & CNG Two-Wheeler Registrations from April 2028. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Phases out fossil-fuel two-wheeler registrations while committing ₹7,000 crore for EV incentives.
Phased Registration Restrictions: From Jan 1, 2027, only electric 3-wheelers and N1 goods carriers allowed; from April 1, 2028, new petrol/CNG 2-wheeler registrations discontinued.
Purchase Subsidies: Up to ₹30,000 for electric 2-wheelers; ₹50,000 for 3-wheelers; ₹1 lakh for N1 trucks (100% road tax/reg fee exemption).
Infrastructure & Bus Fleet: Outlay of ₹7,000 crore to install 32,000 active EV charging points and electrify 30% of school bus fleets by March 2030.
Electric 3-wheeler registration mandate (Jan 1, 2027) vs petrol 2-wheeler ban (April 1, 2028).
